hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the SAP HANA server.

port.title: Port
port.description: SQL port for the SAP HANA database.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username of the SAP HANA database user.

disable_tls.title: Disable TLS
disable_tls.description: Whether to connect without TLS. By default, the connection uses TLS and verifies the server certificate.
